description: Pinned Windows x64 LGPL shared FFmpeg for NEUD ProRes decode. Source: BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (lgpl-shared, no GPL/nonfree).
notes: Artifact name must contain lgpl-shared and must not be a gpl build.
BtbN lgpl-shared builds are configured without --enable-gpl and without --enable-nonfree (verified via embedded configure string: disable-libx264/x265, libavcodec license LGPL).
Shipped LICENSE.txt is GNU LGPL version 3.
NEUD dynamically links shared DLLs only; do not statically link FFmpeg into neud_video.node.
When BtbN updates n8.1-latest, refresh sha256 from checksums.sha256 before rebuilding.
